title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WEAR - Policy
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4wear/Policy. A set of guidelines adopted during the wearable building process and defining how a wearable operates (ETSI TS 103 410-9 clause 4.2.3). The ontology declares no own datatype property for this class beyond the classification itself; name/policyDescription are added for a usable candidate model.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Policy'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

name.description: Property. Short name of the policy.

policyDescription.description: Property. Free-text description of the guideline(s) the policy sets out.
